scope: Three geometry upgrades from newly reviewed source files; separate project-status corrections are in the catalogue.

projects.modelFidelity: Architect-supplied schematic massing; georegistration and base grades remain approximate.
projects.modelCaveat: A100 and native geometry use 82.75 m for A1, while A200 labels 87.75 m. Native geometry is retained. No detailed facade or construction approval is implied.

projects.modelFidelity: Architect-supplied Step 4 design geometry; seven towers, podiums and rooftop structures
projects.modelCaveat: Native proposal geometry includes seven towers, podiums, setbacks and rooftop structures. It is a design proposal, not approved or completed construction. The source design elevations are retained; underground geometry is clipped to the atlas terrain. The terrain is approximate and the vertical datum is not survey-certified. Some drawing title blocks retain older issue labels. The Step 4 cover letter, September 2026 draft PJR and September 22 public presentation support the seven-tower, 3,171-home version. Final facade finishes and construction dates remain unconfirmed. The display model is not a watertight fabrication solid. Original engineering files are retained privately.

projects.modelFidelity: 17 parcel-registered townhome blocks with reference-derived cross-gables; estimated heights and schematic facades
projects.modelCaveat: Seventeen townhome blocks are reconstructed from a parcel-registered artist concept; the cross-gables follow the original image references. Heights, roof proportions and details remain schematic, with estimated uncertainties of ±3 m in height, ±4 m in placement and ±2 m in outlines; these are modelling judgments, not certified tolerances. No native BIM model or approved metric roof drawings were supplied.
